description: This file defines API endpoints related to user authentication, including registration, login, logout, and fetching the current user. It uses FastAPI framework components, interacts with a database via SQLAlchemy, and manages authentication tokens and cookies.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User model representing user data in the database.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Schema for message responses, such as logout confirmation.

methods.name: register(data: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user registration by creating a new user if the email is not already registered.

methods.name: login(data: LoginRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user login, verifies credentials, generates JWT token, and sets authentication cookie.

methods.name: None set_cookie_response(response: Response, token: str)
methods.description: Utility function to set authentication cookie in response.

methods.name: logout(response: Response)
methods.description: Clears authentication cookie to logout user.

methods.name: me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated user's data.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(data: LoginRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):$/
ctags.signature: (data: LoginRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
